title: Camps C1 · 1 of 3 — the roster while “Hide private details” is on
subtitle: Rule v1.000 (design review item 2): Camps hides money while the switch is on, as Color Belt (v0.412) and Star already do. The roster loses the Paid column and “N to collect · $X”; attendance, check-in, Find a camper, “here today”, the pizza count, “Updated …” and the duplicate warning stay. Preview screenshots (fake data, Wed Apr 21 2027 of the April Vacation Camp); amber = what changes. Drawn over the real page — nothing in the app was changed.

items.caption: PC 1280×800. The top bar says “Private details hidden”, yet the roster shows the Paid column (Paid · $245 due · Owes $15) and “6 to collect · $1,355”.

row.caption: Tablet 820×1180 touch. Same Paid column and “6 to collect” (no amount on narrower screens).
Phone 390×844. “6 to collect”, and each card has its money tag (“Paid”, “$245 due”).

items.caption: PC. No Paid column, no “to collect”. The “Possible duplicate” tag isn’t money, so it moves onto the name’s line (as in the walkthrough’s picture 4). Check-in buttons and times stay.

row.caption: Tablet. Same; the day columns get the width.
Phone. Money tags go; “Possible duplicate” stays on its card. (320 wide checked: no sideways scroll.)

footer: Words come from the shared switch code (src/lib/privateDetails.js). Turning the switch off shows everything again. 320 wide checked: no sideways scroll. Not drawn here: the Mark paid box can’t open (its “$X due” tag is gone with the column). Script: mock-c01-roster-hidden.js.
